description: This file contains a function `cost_calculator` for computing the cost of image generation using the Recraft model within the litellm framework. It imports modules for model info retrieval and handles an ImageResponse object to determine the number of images and calculate total cost.

methods.name: float cost_calculator( model: str, image_response: Any, )
methods.description: Calculates the total cost for image generation based on the model info and an ImageResponse object.
